beats.event: Fiery smoke parts to reveal a goblin army in white helmets with wooden shields and spears marching out of the flames; orange march SFX '챙'. The floor-17 mission box above reads 'DEFEAT 30 GOBLIN WARRIORS.' VORTEXSCANS.COM watermark burned into the bottom edge of the art.
In a sunlit forest Gobang, the colossal tattooed barbarian with a small topknot and glowing eye, turns his massive shoulder: 'SUMMONER, YOU CALLED ME.' A voice off-panel calls 'MR. GOBANG.'
Bong Juhyeok grins and points a finger at the viewer, blue-tinted closeup: 'WIPE THEM ALL OUT.'

Gobang ignites — a colossal pillar of golden flame energy erupts around him as he roars 'GRARRR!' skyward, arms spread, blue speed lines and a white blast core. MANGAYY.ORG watermark in the top-right corner.
Gobang charges through the goblin ranks with a red rumble SFX '쿠구구구' as helmeted goblin warriors flank him in the foreground; a goblin growls 'GRR...?' (unclear which one).
Inset bordered panel: a helmeted goblin warrior with glowing red eyes and fangs lunges, thrusting his weapon through a streaked forest background — SFX 'KRAAASH!'
Wide shot: red SFX '챙 철컹' over an army of goblin silhouettes that resolves into ranks of helmeted goblins leveling long spears toward the viewer.

Gobang barrels through, his huge tattooed body crossing the frame with a golden aura streak and a heavy landing SFX '쿵'; goblin spears streak past on the white right side. VORTEXSCANS.COM watermark burned into the art.

Gobang's charge detonates through the goblin ranks — goblins sent flying mid-air among orange light streaks, purple crash SFX '콰앙', a goblin shrieks 'KIEEEEK!', another groans 'UGHK'; Gobang lands crouched, arms crossed, eyes glowing. Diagonal bottom edge.
A lone goblin spear tumbles through empty white air, purple crash SFX '콰앙' echoing.
Goblins crash into the forest floor among brown-striped trees, purple SFX '두두두'; another goblin spear spins down across the frame. Diagonal panel edges.
Juhyeok shields his eyes with one hand, grinning through a nervous sweat drop against fiery smoke: 'WOW... THAT PERFORMANCE IS INSANE.' Diagonal top edge.

A camouflaged K2 tank draped in tangled rental bicycles fires its barrel skyward in a huge explosion, blue SFX '아...다', on a dirt road — the punchline of Juhyeok's analogy: 'STRATEGY AND TACTICS ONLY WORK WHEN THE WEIGHT CLASSES ARE SIMILAR... IT'S LIKE THOUSANDS OF RENTAL BIKES TRYING TO FIGHT A K2 BLACK PANTHER TANK—IT WOULDN'T STAND A CHANCE!' VORTEXSCANS.COM watermark burned into the art.
In the forest Juhyeok stares stunned, grinning with a sweat drop — 'AMAZING.' — a laugh SFX '하하' beside his head; at the right edge a red-haired figure in dark assassin gear leaps into frame.
Against black and yellow lightning a pale-haired man screams in shock, eyes squeezed shut, purple SFX '써' — a witness reacts: 'BOM SANSA...?!' (unclear who speaks).
Chapter title card: the series logo in blue chrome lettering, production credits, and a large numeral 9 on white.

Floor 18 begins: the mission box reads '[FLOOR 18 MISSION: DEFEAT 30 GOBLIN ASSASSINS.]' over dark blue streaks that fade into a red-lit forest; blue rumble SFX '쿠...오오오'; goblin silhouettes scatter along a ridge ('기여..', '구계어...'); below, Juhyeok, a caped figure in dark gear, and Gobang stand facing the army with their backs to the viewer. Caption: 'FLOOR 18 IS GOBLIN ASSASSINS.'
'MOVE OUT.' — Juhyeok points from the lower left as Gobang launches forward, his colossal tattooed frame filling the frame against blue-white streaks; red SFX '쿵쿵'.

Goblin assassins in tattered dark cloaks and red face-masks, eyes glowing white, phase through the forest wrapped in cyan smoke, blue SFX '서벅쌕' — narration: 'SURPRISINGLY, THEY ARE MONSTERS THAT USE STEALTH SKILLS.' VORTEXSCANS.COM watermark burned into the art.

An assassin ambushes Gobang — a small goblin clinging to his chest shows only as a blue dashed outline; orange grip SFX '으어엇', blue chime SFX '띵~'; Gobang blinks down at it: '?'. MANGAYY.ORG watermark in the top-right corner; art dissolves out at the bottom edge.
Gobang stands bewildered in a forest clearing, arms spread, a fish resting on his head — '??' — purple SFX '쿵 움', blue SFX '두거억' as he stomps around searching for the hidden assassins.
Inset bordered panel overlapping the corner of the searching scene: Juhyeok recoils, sweat flying, hand raised — SFX '머쉑' — 'UH...'

On all fours over the teal grass, Gobang channels swirling golden energy arcs around his fists — 'THIS MIGHT NOT BE AS EASY AS I THOUGHT?' — then pounds the ground, black SFX '백': 'COME OUT! ASSASSINS ARE ALL COWARDS!'
Under a storm-grey sky, a vast dark tree-canopy mound looms through radiating speed lines as a booming 'MUHAHAHAHA' laugh rolls over it.

A lean man with swept-back auburn hair in dark sleeveless assassin gear stands hands-on-hips, head thrown back laughing (purple SFX '짓') against a radiant orange backdrop — 'YOU'VE SUFFERED WATCHING THAT IGNORANT BASTARD GOBANG'S STRATEGY UNTIL NOW. I WILL PURIFY YOUR EYES WITH A CLASSY WALKTHROUGH!' — while a chibi-fied Juhyeok slumps in the corner wreathed in purple gloom ('…….'). His boots break the panel's bottom border.

The dark-gear assassin ghosts through a dark navy void wreathed in cyan smoke, grinning, blue neon SFX '쉬웅' — 'THOSE GOBLINS' STEALTH IS NOTHING COMPARED TO MINE.' — a blue skill box flashing 'SHADOW STEP'. VORTEXSCANS.COM watermark burned into the bottom-left of the art.

In a golden void of spotlight beams, the assassin blitzes the goblin assassins — blue afterimages striking from every angle as the goblins burst into purple and green particle showers, purple SFX '셔개 챠챠' — while a blue system box tracks the completion condition '[COMPLETE CONDITION: GOBLIN ASSASSIN .../30]' with the kill counter racing upward (6, 7, 8, 9).
